name: Lead The Charge
description: Spend 1 Hope. Until the start of your next turn, you take –2 Defense, but all allies within medium range get +1d to their attack rolls. You may use this ability once per round.

improvements.name: Break Their Line
improvements.description: You may spend 1 additional Hope to take an additional -3 Defense and give all allies within medium range an additional +1d to their attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
